title: common@2 shared definitions (the defs the version-bump batch changes)
description: STANDALONE: re-declares only the defs that change from common@1 and references every unchanged def absolutely as ../common/v1.schema.json#/$defs/<name> (docs/proposals/VERSION_BUMP_BATCH.md 1.2; enforced by tests/validate/test_common2_lint.py). Immutable once released (ARCHITECTURE.md 3.2). Integers only (4.3).

escape.description: attack_effect (sim #170): the condition ends when the creature wins a Strength check (an action) against dc.

object.description: attack_effect (sim #174): the restraint is a destructible object (the web: AC 10, 5 hp, vulnerable fire, immune bludgeoning / poison / psychic). Any creature in reach or range may attack it; at 0 hp the condition ends.

max_size.description: VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2w: the condition skips a target larger than this (Net, Engulf: large).

regurgitate.description: Swallow only (behir 14, purple worm 21): if the swallower takes `damage` (default 30) or more in one turn from the swallowed creature, it makes a Con save vs dc at the end of that turn; on a failure the creature exits prone within 10 ft (sim places it).

contain.description: VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2w grab and contain: the target is inside the user (engulf: gelatinous cube, with escape; swallow: giant toad, also blinded, total cover from outside, no escape). It takes `damage` at the start of each of the user's turns and is freed when the user dies.

excludes_formless.description: VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2w: the condition has no effect on a creature tagged formless (the Net). Default false.

area.description: Area of effect; sim decides which creatures are inside and passes them as targets.

size_ft.description: Cone/line length, cube side, sphere/cylinder radius.

amount.description: damage_at_most: the event's damage (after resistances) is at most this (sim #158; loader: bad damage_at_most amount).

tag.description: target_tag / not_target_tag (sim #170): a content tag (monster tags[], case-folded; a character race adds itself and 'elf' for every *elf race except half_elf).

feature.description: 7.2zb attack_from_feature: the id of a bonus-attack feature of the same document (flurry_of_blows, martial_arts, or a bonus_attack effect). True only for hits of that feature's bonus attack (Open Hand Technique).

allOf.description: VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2zb (Open Hand Technique): a flag predicate of the target_surprised group plus its feature id.

escape_dc.description: grapple (R-G8, sim #104): escape DC of the Grappled condition the hit applies; 0 or omitted = escape by a contest against the grappler's Athletics. Read only in on_hit[] of monster@4 / character@4 actions[] weapon attacks.

restrains.description: grapple (Druid gap G, monster@5 only): until this grapple ends, the target is restrained (SRD crocodile, constrictor snake, giant frog / toad). Restrained this grapple added ends with it (escape, release, out of reach, grappler incapacitated).

exclusive.description: grapple (Druid gap G, monster@5 only): while this attack holds a creature, the attacker can't use this attack against another target (SRD "can't bite another target").

max_grapples.description: grapple (Druid gap G, monster@5 only): how many creatures this attack can hold at once (SRD giant crab: two claws, each grapples one target = 2). A hit past the limit deals its damage and does not grapple. Omitted = no limit.

instead_of_damage.description: grapple (Tier-A CONTENT_CONVENTIONS §27, monster@5 only): SRD "Instead of dealing damage, the X can grapple the target" (vampire spawn Claws). The attacker chooses per hit (ActionRequest::grapple_instead): a hit with the choice deals no damage and grapples; without it, it deals damage and does not grapple. Can't be combined with restrains.

when.description: sim #170: rider-level predicates, read only in on_hit[] of an attack action (every one must hold).

zero_hp.description: save_effect / save_condition (sim #174): when the damage drops the target to 0 hit points it is stable and gains condition for duration.n rounds (600 = 1 hour, outlasts healing) and while for as long as that lasts (giant spider bite: poisoned 600 rounds, paralyzed while poisoned). Needs damage; condition and while must differ.

amount_from.description: heal_self / temp_hp only (additive, Engine Core loader-duration-temphp; older content unaffected): amount = the owner's `ability` modifier + its level in `class` (omitted = no level term; the class level follows scale.per_levels: classes[] entry, else level), at least `min` (default 1). Computed at load (integers). Dark One's Blessing: {"ability": "cha", "class": "warlock"}.

mode.description: 7.2zb forced_move: push away from the attacker (the forced-movement path, FORCED_MOVEMENT.md).

modifier.description: 7.2zb apply_modifier: a timed modifier on the creature hit (Open Hand: no_reactions until_end_of_caster_next_turn). applies_to self is a load error.

allOf.description: VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2zb: push the creature hit `feet` away; with save, only on a failed save (Open Hand: Str save or pushed 15 ft).
VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2zb: apply one modifier to the creature hit (Open Hand: no reactions until the end of your next turn).

pick_one.description: VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2zb (Open Hand Technique): with choice ask on a hit / crit trigger, the attacker applies exactly one of effects[] (the HitRider window offers one option per effect). Cannot spend a spell slot.

sign.description: 7.2ze Bless (plus) / Bane (minus): the die is added or subtracted; needs die, not with a leading '-' on die (tools/validate and the loader).

all_damage.description: 7.2zi Warding Bond: resistance to every damage type. Not together with damage_type.

ability.description: Save / AbilityCheck scope (else all). 7.2zc: "chosen" = the caster picks the ability at cast (ActionRequest::mark_ability; Hex); ability_check modifiers of a spell apply_modifier with scope {target: marked} only.

applies_to.description: 7.2zd attackers (Protection from Evil and Good): an attack_roll row on the target that applies to the attack rolls of creatures attacking it; scope from_types filters their creature type. 7.2ze: a list of roll kinds (attack, save; roll_kind_list values) instead puts the row on the targets and applies its die to those rolls (Bless / Bane); attack_roll or save modifiers with die only, and the list includes the modifier's own stat.

consume.description: Timed modifier is spent early (sim: ModifierSpec::consume 1/2/3): next_attack = after the target's next attack roll (True Strike, Vicious Mockery); next_attack_against = after the next attack roll made against the target (Guiding Bolt); until_damaged = when the target takes damage. Combines with any duration (first wins).

speed_sub.description: speed only: feet subtracted after speed_scale, clamped at 0 (Ray of Frost 10).

ac_floor.description: ac only: AC is at least this value before flat bonuses (Barkskin 16, Mage Armor 13 + Dex with ac_floor_dex). The 'not wearing armor' condition is the author's concern.

ac_floor_dex.description: ac only, needs ac_floor: add the target's Dex modifier to the floor.

per_turn.description: temp_hp only: grant the bonus again at the start of each of the target's turns until the modifier expires (Heroism).

when.description: attack_roll, ac, damage, attacks_against only: every predicate (row 9 vocabulary) must hold for the modifier to apply.

then.description: 7.2zi Ray of Enfeeblement: ability must be str (tools/validate and the loader). Weapon attacks that use Strength deal half damage, round down.

applies_to.description: 7.2za subtract_roll: the creature's rolls it may answer (Cutting Words: attack, check, damage). Absent = attack.

applies_to_attack.description: VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2zb reduce_damage (Deflect Missiles): only damage from an attack hit of these kinds. Absent = any damage, as before.

requires_sight.description: VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2y: only when the reactor can see the creature that triggered the window (Uncanny Dodge: an attacker that you can see).

range.description: [normal, long] range in feet (SRD range 80/320 = [80, 320]); targets beyond normal and up to long range are attacked with disadvantage.

damage.description: BASE damage: weapon die + ability modifier (+ magic bonus). Never fold feature bonuses (e.g. Dueling +2) in; feature effects such as damage_bonus are applied by the engine.

qualifiers.description: monster@3 / character@3: what the weapon is made of / counts as, for qualified resistances (nonmagical, silvered, adamantine). Inert in earlier versions.

range.description: [normal, long] range in feet (SRD range 80/320 = [80, 320]); targets beyond normal and up to long range are attacked with disadvantage.

attack.description: attack_effect (sim #170): the attack roll's mode; default ranged.

half_hp_damage.description: Swarm (sim #172): weapon attacks only; replaces the dice of damage[0] while the attacker has half its hit points or fewer (SRD swarm bites: 2d6, or 1d6 at half HP or fewer). Needs at least one die.

long_range_ft.description: attack_effect (sim #174): ranged only; long range in feet, greater than range_ft. Legal out to long_range_ft, at disadvantage beyond range_ft (giant spider Web 30/60).

zero_hp.description: save_effect / save_condition (sim #174): when the damage drops the target to 0 hit points it is stable and gains condition for duration.n rounds (600 = 1 hour, outlasts healing) and while for as long as that lasts (giant spider bite: poisoned 600 rounds, paralyzed while poisoned). Needs damage; condition and while must differ.

control.description: VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2y: save_effect only (class feature save actions: Turn Undead, Turn the Unholy). command is spell-only (load error).

control_excludes_creature_types.description: 7.2y: save_effect with control only; creature types the control has no effect on.

destroy_undead_max_cr8.description: 7.2y: save_effect with control turned only (Destroy Undead).

target_creature_types.description: 7.2y: save_effect only; only creatures of these types are targeted (others make no save and take nothing): Turn Undead [undead], Turn the Unholy [fiend, undead].

duration.description: 7.2y: save_effect with control only; the control lasts n rounds (Turn Undead: 1 minute = 10).

allOf.description: sim #170 compile_attack_effect: an attack roll that only applies conditions (giant spider Web); every apply[] entry has a Strength escape.
VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2y: the control / target_creature_types keys are save_effect only.

effect_inert.description: Migrated/stamped effect of a kind in the FROZEN 3->4 list (docs/proposals/VERSION_BUMP_BATCH.md 8.2 step 4): any parameters, never applied, not validated.

allOf.description: R-G12 (7.2q) closed kinds: wild_shape / shapechanger are validated only by their own arms (not the open v1 effect). Kept apart from the frozen 3 -> 4 list above.
VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2p: a gaze effect is checked by its closed arm (the inline gaze arm of $defs/effect) only.
sim #179: an extra_attack effect is checked by its closed arm ($defs/extra_attack_effect) only.
7.2w: a transparent effect is checked by its closed arm ($defs/transparent_effect) only.
7.2z: a bonus_attack effect is checked by its closed arm only.
7.2za: a grant_die effect is checked by its closed arm only.
7.2za: a half_proficiency effect is checked by its closed arm only.
7.2zb: a spell_mod effect is checked by its closed arm only.
7.2zc: a heal_bonus effect is checked by its closed arm only.

target.description: 7.2zc generic mark: spells only (spell@1 apply_modifier scope); on a feature it is a load error.

from_types.description: 7.2zd: the attackers an applies_to attackers row applies to (rows of any other applies_to: a load error).

scope.description: VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2y / 7.2z: one closed object, at least one key. weapon wielded: bound to the melee weapon wielded at activation (Sacred Weapon). attack / ability: the attack-roll and damage rows apply only to that kind of weapon attack using that ability (Rage: {attack: melee_weapon, ability: str}). 7.2zc: target marked is the spell@1 generic mark key; a feature refuses it. 7.2zd: from_types (creature types, unique) for applies_to attackers rows.

ends_early.description: 7.2z (Rage): no_attack_or_damage_since_last_turn: ends at the end of the owner's turn unless it attacked a hostile or took damage since its last turn; unconscious: ends at once when it falls unconscious.

blocks.description: 7.2z (Rage): casting: casting spells is refused while it lasts; concentration: the owner's concentration breaks when it starts.

advantage_on.description: 7.2z: advantage on ability checks / saving throws of these abilities while it lasts (Rage: Str); on a passive effect: the saves (Danger Sense).

on_end.description: 7.2z (Frenzy): exhaustion levels gained when the effect ends. When a bonus_attack names this effect in requires_effect, only if that bonus attack was made while it lasted.

passive.description: 7.2z (Danger Sense): always on, nothing to activate. Needs advantage_on {saves} and when; no cost, usage, duration, modifier(s), scope, ends_early, blocks or on_end.

when.description: 7.2z passive only: the save it applies to, against effects the creature can see (source_seen, vision 7.2x), not while it has any of not_conditions (Danger Sense: dex, true, [blinded, deafened, incapacitated]).

allOf.description: 7.2z: when only on a passive effect.
7.2z: a passive effect: advantage_on and when, nothing activated.

usage.description: 7.2zd split form: the cost (Channel Divinity: {kind: pool, pool: channel_divinity}).

per_class_level.description: 7.2zd Preserve Life: the hit points to divide = per_class_level x the level in `class` (absent: the total level).

class.description: 7.2zd split form: whose class level per_class_level counts (absent: the total character level).

range_ft.description: 7.2zd split form: every creature healed is within this distance of the user.

cap.description: 7.2zd split form: no creature above half its hit point maximum; one already at or above half gets nothing.

excludes_types.description: 7.2zd split form: creature types that cannot be healed (Preserve Life: undead, construct). Omitted: tools/validate warns.

heal_pool_effect.description: Row 13 Lay on Hands: {pool} (spend ActionRequest::amount from the pool). 7.2zd Preserve Life split form: {per_class_level, range_ft, cap, usage, excludes_types?, class?} (ActionRequest::heal_split; the two forms don't mix).

challenge_rating.description: A monster@4 challenge.rating string (no floats). Compared as CR*8 (0, 1/8 = 1, 1/4 = 2, 1/2 = 4, n = 8n).

transform_forms.description: R-G12 (7.2q) beast forms: monster@N content ids resolved across the pack set (dependency packs included); each must be a beast. form_archetype = 1 + index into this list (u8, so at most 255). A repeat is a validator error (not uniqueItems, so the message names it).

level.description: Class level from which this row applies.

wild_shape_effect.description: R-G12 (VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2q) Druid Wild Shape, a character feature. Loader: Engine Core build_form / feature_spec (FeatureSpec form 2). Reserved until that loader lands (the validator's unknown-kind warning). No duration key: the engine computes it (600 * (class level / 2) rounds).

pool.description: resources[].id of the uses pool; must recharge on short_rest (max 2 expected).

class.description: Class whose level drives max_cr_by_level and the duration. Default druid.

max_cr_by_level.description: Highest beast CR per class level; levels strictly ascending. The row with the largest level <= the class level applies.

no_fly_below.description: No form with a fly speed below this class level. Default 8.

no_swim_below.description: No form with a swim speed below this class level. Default 4.

speed.description: Replaces the whole speed object (not merged).

actions.description: ids of this document's own actions[] usable in the form; omitted = all; [] = none (warning).

shapechanger_effect.description: R-G12 (VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2q) shapechanger trait (monster or character): the forms listed are merged over the creature's own block, one HP pool. Needs the #141 creature fact shapechanger: true. Loader: Engine Core build_form (FeatureSpec form 3). Reserved until that loader lands.

extra_attack_effect.description: sim #179 (features.cpp apply_extra_attack): SRD Extra Attack. The Attack action makes attacks_per_action weapon attacks (rules5e Combatant::attacks_per_action; grapple / shove replace one, movement between them allowed). Required, no default. Several declarations: the highest wins (no stacking; the validator warns). Characters only (character@4 features[]); in a file that declares character@3 or older the sim lists it inert (the 3 -> 4 migration's kind list is frozen).

oneOf.description: VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2p Petrifying Gaze (sim #153 content.cpp compile_gaze; basilisk, medusa). At the start of each other creature's turn, if it sees the gazer within range_ft and does not avert its eyes, it makes the save; on a failure it gains `condition` (repeat save per `repeat_save`); with `escalates`, a failed repeat save (or failing the first save by escalate_margin or more, when escalate_margin > 0) gives `escalate_to`. monster@4 / character@4 only (the sim lists it inert in a file that declares an older version). Loader defaults: condition restrained, repeat_save end_of_turn, escalates false, escalate_to petrified, escalate_margin 0 (the validator warns when condition, repeat_save or escalate_to is omitted).

condition.description: Condition on a failed save. Loader default restrained.

repeat_save.description: When the affected creature repeats the save (success ends it). Loader default end_of_turn.

escalates.description: A failed repeat save turns the condition into escalate_to. Default false.

escalate_to.description: The escalated condition. Loader default petrified.

escalate_margin.description: Failing the first save by this much or more gives escalate_to at once (medusa: 5). 0 = never (default).

requires_humanoid_form.description: R-G12 (7.2q), default false: the feature is not usable while in a Wild Shape form (rules UseFeature refuses: 'feature not usable in this form'). Error on the wild_shape feature itself; warning without a wild_shape feature in the document.

trait_active.description: A trait whose effect is mechanically applied by the engine (@4). Differs from the v1 def only in effect (-> common@2 effect).

spellcasting.description: monster@4 / character@4: strict superset of common@1 spellcasting (all v1 fields, same meaning) plus dc / attack_bonus overrides and an innate block.

slots.description: Spell slots per spell level, keys "1".."9".

pact.description: Pact Magic: slots all of one level, restored on a short rest.

dc.description: Optional override of the derived 8 + proficiency + ability modifier save DC.

attack_bonus.description: Optional override of the derived spell attack bonus.

per_day.description: Key = uses per day (1..9), value = spell content ids.

stat_block.description: Fields shared by monster@4 and character@4 (common@1 stat_block with the v2 action / trait / reaction / resource defs).

control_kind.description: VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2v control conditions on a spell@1 save effect: turned (Turn Undead; no condition, ends on damage), fear (with condition frightened), laughter (Hideous Laughter, with condition prone), command (no condition; ActionRequest::command_word).

control_repeat_save.description: VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2v additive repeat_save arms: end_of_turn_unseen (Fear: only while the target can't see the caster), end_of_turn_or_damage_advantage (Hideous Laughter: end of each turn, and on damage with advantage).

destroy_undead_max_cr8.description: VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2v Destroy Undead threshold as CR x 8 (SRD: 1/2 = 4, 1 = 8, 2 = 16, 3 = 24, 4 = 32).

bonus_vs.description: VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2y: extra dice of the same damage type against a target of one of creature_types (Divine Smite +1d8 vs undead / fiend). Weapon attack damage[] entries and on_hit extra_damage entries; rolled with the entry and doubled on a critical.

transparent_effect.description: VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2w (T&C spec): SRD Transparent (gelatinous cube). Even in plain sight, spotting the creature while it has neither moved nor attacked takes a Wisdom (Perception) check vs dc (rules5e Combatant::transparent_dc, read by sim's surprise setup). Monsters only (monster@4 traits[]; the validator refuses it on characters); declared more than once: the highest dc wins (the validator warns). In a file that declares monster@3 or older the sim lists it inert.

bonus_attack_effect.description: VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2z (Frenzy): one melee weapon attack as a bonus action while the apply_modifier feature requires_effect (an id of a feature of the same document) is in force.

roll_kind_list.description: VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2za: the rolls a die applies to (rules5e kRoll* bits): attack roll, saving throw, ability check, damage roll (the attack's weapon or spell damage dice). Shared by grant_die and the subtract_roll reaction.

grant_die_effect.description: VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2za (T&C #202): SRD Bardic Inspiration (sim features.cpp apply_grant_die). Using the feature (UseFeature, target = an ally other than the user, within range_ft, not deafened) gives the target one held die (rules5e ModStat::HeldDie). Once, after it rolls a roll in applies_to and before the outcome, the holder may add the die; then it is gone. It lapses after duration; a new held die replaces an older one (one per creature). The die is the last scale entry whose level is at or below the owner's level in `class` (else the total level), else `die`. character@4 / monster@4 (inert below 4).

scale.description: Levels strictly ascending (the validator checks the order).

half_proficiency_effect.description: VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2za (T&C #202): SRD Jack of All Trades (sim features.cpp apply_half_proficiency; rules5e Combatant::half_proficiency). Static. checks: half the proficiency bonus, rounded down, on ability checks that do not already add it; initiative: the same on initiative rolls. Characters only (refused on monsters); inert below @4.

spell.description: The spell modified (a content id the pack defines; the validator warns when the document's spellcasting does not list it).

damage_bonus_ability.description: Add this ability's modifier to the damage of each attack hit (beam) of the spell (Agonizing Blast: cha).

on_hit_push_ft.description: Push the creature hit this far away per hit beam (Repelling Blast: 10), on the forced-movement path.

spell_mod_effect.description: VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2zb (Agonizing / Repelling Blast): static per-spell modification, per attack hit of that spell. Characters only (the loader refuses it on monsters); character@4 only (older files list it inert).

flat.description: Extra hit points per creature healed (Disciple of Life: 2). Default 0.

per_spell_level.description: Also add the level of the slot the spell was cast with (Disciple of Life: true).

heal_bonus_effect.description: VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2zc (Disciple of Life): static. Each creature a healing spell cast with a spell slot of 1st level or higher heals regains flat (+ the slot level when per_spell_level) more hit points (rules5e Combatant::heal_bonus_*). Healing riders, pools (Lay on Hands) and feature heals do not count, nor innate casts. Characters only (the loader refuses it on monsters); character@4 only (older files list it inert).
